problem: Cargo 1.97 ignores profile.test panic, so requiring an explicit test panic=unwind setting would create a warning without enforcing behavior.
resolution: Require explicit unwind for dev/release and a machine assertion that test has no abort or ignored panic override, preserving Cargo test-harness unwind semantics.

problem: A pinned GPUI revision cannot enter Cargo.lock unless an approved UI crate consumes it.
resolution: Add the pinned workspace gpui dependency to desktop-ui and taskbar-ui and extend the architecture allowlist for those UI owners.

problem: The checker treated a missing forbidden-substring property as a wildcard and rejected allowed UI dependencies.
resolution: Only evaluate forbidden substrings when a crate has an explicit policy entry; rerun positive and negative architecture gates.
